judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation and WeakMap caching logic, but fails several explicit acceptance criteria and introduces lint/build errors. Specifically, it uses a 4-line JSDoc block on `execute` instead of the required one-line comment (which the ticket explicitly warns will fail `re-lint/max-comment-lines`) and uses `as any` in `registry.ts` and `registry.test.ts` (`@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` with `--max-warnings 0`). It completely omits the required tests for passing extra unlisted properties through unchanged (`toEqual`) and throwing `Unknown tool: <name>` for unregistered tools, and puts the orchestrator loop test in a new `.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Furthermore, it leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository, updates `.specify/spec.md` without recording that extra properties pass through unmodified or that the tool-round bound stops retry cycles, and creates a fake dated release in `CHANGELOG.md` instead of adding to `[Unreleased]` with the migration note.
